resources.string:
MC Launcher — a Minecraft Java Edition launcher manager for Android.

Downloads versions, libraries, assets, mods and resource packs into isolated instances and assembles the Java launch command.

Important: Minecraft Java Edition native libraries (LWJGL/OpenAL) are built for desktop (Windows/Linux/macOS x86/x64), and Android uses ART rather than a standard JVM. Running the game on Android additionally requires a JVM port plus Android-native LWJGL (the approach used by the open-source PojavLauncher). This app manages instances and assembles the launch command; actually executing the game requires that JVM/LWJGL port, which is documented in README.md.
